facts.situation: David and Susan Clarke are both retired. Their objectives and circumstances are unchanged since the last review. Both remain comfortable with risk profile 5 (balanced). Neither currently needs income from the portfolio. They want to simplify their holdings rather than retain the joint GIA alongside their individual ISAs. Both ISAs are already part-funded for the current tax year. The joint GIA valuation seen during the meeting was described as a little over £45,000; the recorded figure is approximate.

actions.action: Disinvest the jointly held Holloway GIA H-GIA-J in full.
actions.amount: Full value of the joint GIA

actions.action: Use the joint GIA proceeds to top up David's ISA H-ISA-D and Susan's ISA H-ISA-S, split equally between the two ISAs.
